description.narrative: Cogna Educação S.A. (Cogna or the Group), the largest private for-profit educational group in Brazil, and one of the largest in the world. The Group started as a pre-university course and entered the higher education sector in the 90s and became a listed in 2007. Cogna currently attends more than 2.56 million students from kindergarten to higher education and employs approximately 23 thousand people. The proposed investment is an A loan for IFCs own account in an amount of up to US$100 million equivalent in Brazilian Reais (BRL) and aims to support Cognas financing of investments in technology during the next 2-3 years in its higher education segment (no funds used for K-12) (the Project).

The Project will support the Companys digital transformation, investing in technology to integrate and upgrade its education systems into one digital platform, thereby enhancing the quality of affordable higher education. Through this Project, the Company will not only enhance student experience and engagement but also improve operational efficiencies, enabling students easier access to the education platform with better product offerings for distance learning and hybrid courses. This will ultimately lead to affordable education options for students across Brazil. By leveraging state-of-the-art technologies such as Artificial Intelligence and data analytics, the Company will further improve the quality and relevance of education, aligning its curriculum with market and student demands and enhancing learning outcomes. This will contribute to narrowing the skill mismatches of graduates in the labor market, resulting in improved employment opportunities post-graduation. In addition, the Project will contribute to enhancing competitiveness in the private higher education market in Brazil by supporting the Companys strategic investment in cutting-edge technology, such as an integrated digital education platform. Through this Project, coupled with its hybrid learning and innovative digital curriculum, the Company will demonstrate its business strategy of enhancing the digital platform, which can be replicated by other private higher education providers, promoting a broader digital transformation within the higher education market in Brazil. As the leading trend-setter in the market, the Companys embrace of advanced digital technologies will likely establish new benchmarks for educational delivery in Brazil, spurring innovation and technological adoption across the higher education sector. This is expected to catalyze a ripple effect, accelerating other higher education providers integration of digital technologies into various facets of teaching.
